question: footway names geojson
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 5

question: residential road start coordinates rounded
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS start_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' LIMIT 10

question: road class share percent
sql: SELECT class, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY n DESC

question: longest roads km
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) / 1000.0, 3) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads ORDER BY ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) DESC LIMIT 5

question: secondary road midpoint wkt
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ST_AsText(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS center_wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' LIMIT 5

question: speed limit label format
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, CONCAT(speed_limits[1].max_speed.value, ' ', speed_limits[1].max_speed.unit) AS speed_limit FROM lisbon_roads WHERE speed_limits[1].max_speed.value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10
